goalNotes: These are your own daily targets; your goals plan's estimate is about 2,150 kcal a day.

nutrition.targetNote: Your calorie target is below your estimated minimum of about 1,400 kcal a day, which covers your resting energy and training. Eating this little for long can harm training and health, so ask Coach to review it with you.

hydration.note: An estimate from your weight and the day's training, not a minimum. Thirst and pale urine are good everyday signs.

priorities.title: Start with how you feel
priorities.reason: A quick check-in gives your training and food choices some context.

priorities.title: Choose a session that fits today
priorities.reason: Review your programme and how you feel. A rest day can be part of your plan.

priorities.title: Keep your food picture up to date
priorities.reason: 1500 kcal and 115 g protein across 1 logged meal. These are recorded totals, not your full daily intake.
